files: copied: legacy MultiplayerPowerups.tsx, BoostPads.jsx, trackRecovery.ts, MultiplayerKart.tsx (constants)

wallRules.wall: a GLB triangle (any rendered mesh) with |normal.y| < 0.7, centroid within 80 m of the centreline
wallRules.sweep: constrainMeshMovement tests a 1.15 m sphere at the logical plane y=0, so a wall triangle counts when it reaches into y -1.15..1.15; its segment is the triangle sliced at the height in that range nearest y=0 (the closest point, flattened). Lower faces (the sand verge lip, kerb edges) never collide on the web either.
wallRules.probe: checkHorizontalCollisionFast rays run at y=0.5, so probe segments are the wall triangles sliced at y=0.5; materials are double-sided, so both faces hit
wallRules.normal: [nx, nz] = the triangle geometric normal (as three.js reports face.normal), x and z of the unit 3D vector, not renormalised
wallRules.merge: collinear touching pieces facing the same way are joined; the union of lines is unchanged
wallRules.format: segments: flat [ax, az, bx, bz, nx, nz, ...] in three.js world metres, no rebase

dirtGrid.rule: cell centre down-ray from y=1, far 3: the first hit with |normal.y| >= 0.7 is dirt if its mesh is Object_11 "ground dirt" (MultiplayerKart.tsx:1588-1610)
dirtGrid.runsFormat: [row, firstCol, lastCol]; cell (col,row) covers x minX+col*cellM.., z minZ+row*cellM..

meshColliders.note: painted speed quad, no gameplay effect

ipCleanup.rebuild: violetGarden.ts: hedges on the barrier blocks, a stone gate on the start structure, terrain for the hills, crystals for the motifs

exportNotes: collision.walls holds the GLB wall faces as the web sweep (role "sweep") and probe rays (role "probe") meet them (collision.wallRules); collision.dirtGrid marks where the first floor hit under the kart is Object_11 "ground dirt". collision.profileWalls is the older profile trace, for reference.
